name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2068: The retention plan is a chain of REASONS NOT TO DELETE checked in order, so an earlier reason hides every later one. Measured on his 35 reels: 12 never-swept, 11 sealed-with-zero-pages, 5 recent, 1 vault-owes, 6 eligible - and the v2056 rule fired ZERO times. On his footage a working v2056 and a deleted one are indistinguishable, which is the mirror of a blind fixture: real data, right gate, still green. The plan now counts its own branches and names the ones it never reached, reported as UNMEASURED rather than as fine or as broken. NOT REACHED and NOT APPLICABLE are kept apart: target-met cannot fire without a free_mb target, so it is unreachable by construction rather than untested by the footage, and folding them together would make an inert branch look like a rule that quietly stopped working.
